mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_BALANCE ( USER_ID, BALANCE, TOTAL_BALANCE, OPERATION, COMMENT, SUBTRACT_UNIT_PRICE, SMS_PRICE, LMS_PRICE, MMS_PRICE, REFUND, REG_DATE, REG_ID ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{balance}, #{totalBalance}, #{operation}, #{comment}, #{subtractUnitPrice}, #{smsPrice}, #{lmsPrice}, #{mmsPrice}, #{refund}, NOW(), #{regId} )
mapper.select: SELECT SEQ AS seq, USER_ID AS userId, BALANCE AS balance, TOTAL_BALANCE AS totalBalance, OPERATION AS operation, COMMENT AS comment, SUBTRACT_UNIT_PRICE AS subtractUnitPrice, SMS_PRICE AS smsPrice, LMS_PRICE AS lmsPrice, MMS_PRICE AS mmsPrice, REFUND AS refund, REG_DATE AS regDate, REG_ID AS regId FROM TB_BALANCE WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} ORDER BY SEQ DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT SEQ AS seq, USER_ID AS userId, BALANCE AS balance, TOTAL_BALANCE AS totalBalance, OPERATION AS operation, COMMENT AS comment, SUBTRACT_UNIT_PRICE AS subtractUnitPrice, SMS_PRICE AS smsPrice, LMS_PRICE AS lmsPrice, MMS_PRICE AS mmsPrice, REFUND AS refund, REG_DATE AS regDate, REG_ID AS regId FROM TB_BALANCE WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} ORDER BY SEQ DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
